title: Notification for Cancellation of Advertisement for the post of Assistant - Land Management (LDCE)
text:
KEY LINES:
In pursuance of the letter vide no. LMD-11017/2/2025/E-263206/1672 dated 7h October.
Assistant (LDCE) under the Department of Land Management, issued vide Advertisement No.

FULL TEXT:
Aesh Public Service
No. PSC-R(B)-05/2021
Itana 2
ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PỤBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
ADVERTISEMENT CANCELLATION NOTICE
OF LIMITED DEPARTMENTAL COMPETITIVE EXAMINATION FOR THE POST OF
ASSISTANT (LAND MANAGEMENT)
Dated Itanagar, the6h October, 2026
In pursuance of the letter vide no. LMD-11017/2/2025/E-263206/1672 dated 7h October.
2025, received from the Department of Land Management, GoAP, regarding withdrawal of 1 (one)
post of Assistant (LDCE), Group-B Ministerial (N/G), and in pursuance of the decision of the
Commission recorded in the Minutes of the Meeting vide no. PSC-Chairman/05/Minutes/2024
dated 21 August, 2026, the Commission has decided to cancel the advertisement for the post of
Assistant (LDCE) under the Department of Land Management, issued vide Advertisement No.
PSC-R(B)-05/202 1 dated 20h July. 2022.
This issues with the approval of the Commission.
Memo No. PSC-R(B)-05/2021
